title: The Latest Crier for Oct 02, 2026
items:
VOTE FOR HOMECOMING ROYALTY!

VOTE FOR HOMECOMING ROYALTY! It’s time to choose this year’s Homecoming Royalty! 

Six students from the Class of 2027 and students graduating in December 2026 have been nominated. Cast your vote for TWO students to be crowned the 2026 Homecoming Royalty! 

Voting is open from Monday, September 28 through Thursday, October 1 at 5:00 PM 

The top two students will be announced and crowned at Homecoming Coronation on Friday, October 2 at 6:45 PM! 

Voting Link: 

Homecoming Royalty Voting 2026

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

ADA Accommodations

Need ADA Accommodations for your midterms?

Knock, Knock! ITS will be entering every res hall room on campus!

Please check your email for more information. Remember to take your keys on your hall/house's designated day so that you aren't locked out. Contact your RA or area coordinator with questions or concerns!

Homecoming 2026 | Dutch Around the World

IT'S HOMECOMING WEEK! Check out all of the events happening this weekend to show your Central spirit! 
Homecoming 2026 Schedule

Men's & Women's Retreat/Getaway/Vacation! (Fall Break)

Calling all students! Want to get away for fall break? Stay in an awesome airbnb? Looking for some community? Join us for a weekend away, October 16-18, for tourist excursions, games, campfires, worship, GREAT food, coffee, Bible study, thrifting, & much more on the CM Men’s & Women's retreat. Both men are & women are headed to Des Moines. P.S. It is only $50! Email/talk to Hannah Goemaat in the lower chapel! Sign up here (spots limited): https://forms.gle/VqQqei6zqTEqZ3EE6

Flying Pans ALUMNI Steel Band presents DESPANADO Sunday Oct 4th!

The Flying Pans ALUMNI Steel Band will perform their 20th Anniversay concert of DESPANADO, a Tropical Tribute featuring the music of the EAGLES, on Sunday October 4th @ 1pm in Douwstra Auditorium including the songs TAKE IT EASY, THE BEST OF MY LOVE, DESPERADO, HEARTACHE TONIGHT and HOTEL CALIFORNIA. The current members of the Flying Pans Steel Band will also perform as guest artists during the show with the songs MIDNIGHT FLYER and WITCHY WOMAN. FREE CONCERT!!

Fellowship of Christian Athletes

YOU’RE INVITED! 
Want to build your Christian community here on campus? Join FCA next Tuesday, 10/6 , in the BMW rooms at 8pm . Our leaders will be guiding us through discussions on the sins we tolerate and what the Bible says about them. It will be a great night of learning and fellowship! 

Worship Night: 

On Tuesday the following week, 10/13 , FCA and the other ministries on campus are putting on a Worship Night at the fire pit near the pond. We hope to see you there to enjoy worship with other students and smores! 

- FCA Leadership Team

Fall Intramural Sign-Ups

Fall Intramural sign-ups are open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! Follow along on our Instagram (@CentralCollegeIM) for updates on when sign-ups open/close! 
Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim

Language Placement Test

Students who need to take a Language Placement Test for Spanish or German can stop by the Vermeer Science Center (VSC), Room #241 from 11:00am-12:00pm on Tuesday, October 13th. Use the following link to add your name and select a time to confirm your attendance. Contact Dr. Ally Krogstad ( krogstada@central.edu ) or Prof. Oscar Reynaga ( reynagao@central.edu ) if you have any questions.

FALL BREAK TRIP TO CIVIL WAR BATTLEFIELDS IN TENNESSEE

You are invited to join History Club and Drs. Barloon and L.Witt over Fall Break to see the battlefields where most Iowa regiments fought in the Civil War over 160 years ago: Shiloh, Corinth, and Forts Henry & Donelson in Tennessee. Learn what happened, hike the battlefields, see the Fall colors! Cost of the trip is $240 for 3 nights lodging plus meal money. History Club will pay for one meal and the cost of travel. Leaving Friday, Oct. 16th at noon and returning Monday, October 19th. Let Drs. Barloon or L.Witt know if you want to go by Friday, October 9th.
